sections.description: Generates a client-side JSON search index and powers fuzzy search with local Fuse.js for Simply Static exports.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/static-search-index directory, or install via GitHub releases.
  2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' screen in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Added support for public custom post types in search index generation.
  • Renamed main plugin classes to Sahajanand_Static_Search.
  • Added self-hosted update checker support.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
